units: PRIME-moderated z scores. Center each landmark within source cell line using all eligible RNAi interventions, then quality-weighted across contexts and downweight sign disagreement. No conversion to LFC or counts.
quality: RNAi trt_sh.cgs only, at least3 hairpin signatures and positive sister consistency. Overexpression/vector controls excluded. At least3 source cell contexts for support; different lines not treated as independent donor replicates.
gene_mapping: Exact unique symbol match only; no guessed aliases or imputed output genes. Own target omitted from transferable features.
PRIME_note: Source publication discusses PC1 removal for CGS; this does not eliminate shRNA seed effects. Cross-assay calibration must be validated.
